summary: Adlai Nortye Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the first patient dosed in the intermittent weekly dosing (QW) arm of a global Phase 1 trial for its pan-RAS(ON) inhibitor AN9025. The filing describes a clinical milestone in an ongoing study for advanced solid tumors harboring RAS mutations. No financial terms, transaction, or special situation event is disclosed. The trial is conducted under a license agreement with Jiangsu Aosaikang Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd. The announcement is a routine operational update with no actionable risk-arb angle or special situation.
